headline: Bitcoin Slips to One-Month Low of $76,500 Ahead of US Midterms
summary: Bitcoin fell to a one-month low around $76,500 as digital asset investors exercised caution ahead of the upcoming U.S. midterm elections.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, highly sensitive to macro liquidity expectations and regulatory shifts in the United States.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin prices fell to $76,500 amid political uncertainty surrounding U.S. elections.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor caution ahead of the U.S. midterm elections led to risk reduction across crypto markets.
